svg.text: I improved geographic resource search, restored missing citations by adding a
retrieval step before generation, and fixed session handling so follow-up
messages retained context. I also migrated inference to Amazon Nova 2 Lite.
HOPE connects users with WestCare Arizona resources. I worked on location-
aware search and the location questionnaire, corrected how the first request
obtains a Bedrock session ID, and carried that ID into later messages. I also
fixed source display for off-topic responses, updated cross-region inference
permissions, and wrote a customization guide.
